content.title: Memphis Grizzlies at Denver Nuggets - Where to Watch, Stream Info, TV Channel, and Live Updates (April 08, 2026)
content.text: The Memphis Grizzlies will face off against the Denver Nuggets in a matchup highlighting contrasting fortunes for both teams. The Grizzlies enter the game with a record of 25-54, currently on a five-game losing streak. In stark contrast, the Nuggets boast a strong 51-28 record and are riding a nine-game winning streak, solidifying their position as one of the top teams in the league. Nikola Jokić leads the Nuggets with impressive averages of 28 points, 12.9 rebounds, and 10.9 assists per game. Meanwhile, Ty Jerome is the scoring leader for the Grizzlies, averaging 19.7 points per game. Both teams will be looking to make a statement, with the Nuggets aiming to extend their winning streak and the Grizzlies seeking to break their slump.
